stories.title: Oklahoma AD rips Ole Miss, SEC for Sunday game; Rebels defend travel efforts
stories.summary: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny ripped the SEC and Ole Miss for the "inexplicable" decision to move its game to Sunday, while the Rebels defended their travel efforts.

stories.title: Ohio State's 'dominant' Smith sets Big Ten receiving mark, states Heisman case
stories.summary: Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith broke yet another record, eclipsing the Big Ten mark for career receiving yards while also making his Heisman Trophy case in Saturday's win over Northwestern.

stories.title: Pulisic leads USMNT to 6-goal rout of Haiti ahead of Pochettino's farewell
stories.summary: The USMNT beat Haiti 6-0 in the first leg of its Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal, in what was Mauricio Pochettino's penultimate game in charge.

stories.title: 2027 UGA football commit dies following 'sudden medical emergency'
stories.summary: Marcellus Young Casario, a Georgia football commit, died Friday after experiencing a "sudden medical emergency," according to his high school.

stories.title: Patriots place RB Henderson on IR with still unexplained illness
stories.summary: The Patriots placed RB TreVeyon Henderson on injured reserve while he deals with an unexplained neurological issue.
